key_insight: A manufactured modular X-ray inspection system combines automated pipe handling and ±1 mm weld positioning for pipes 40–508 mm in diameter and 6–12 m long.
engineering_relevance: The design integrates internal or external weld inspection, servo positioning, and structural verification into an industrial pipe-inspection platform.
method: Surveyed site layout and overhead-crane feeding requirements.
Designed rail-guided transport, a height-adjustable X-ray positioning arm, and imaging at 25 cm intervals.
Combined servo control, laser position verification, and absolute encoder feedback with finite element analysis and experimental testing.
evidence_signal: Structural analyses predicted peak stresses of 133.5 MPa in the arm and 211.1 MPa in the rail vehicle, with safety factors of 3.1 and 1.96; experimental validation was reported without quantitative agreement metrics.
watch_item: Defect-detection accuracy, inspection throughput, and radiation-shielding performance are not quantified in the abstract.
paper_title: Design and Validation of an Automated X-Ray Imaging System for Pipe Weld Inspection
